objective: Decide R49 or isolate exact unresolved conditions without presupposing the answer
contract: Finite nonnegative BF16 magnitudes x<=amax, F32 RN-even(amax/6), gradual underflow, b32, virtual RNE-p with binary64 exponent range; target p49 within p35..64
independent_review: A separate internal agent audits the p53 proof from definitions and may use its own limited integer checks; it does not accept the draft by assumption
main_check: Enumerate scale coefficient A and the analytically bounded t only: q15 A1..255 t1..16, q16 A128..255 t1..4, q17 A128..191 t1. At most 4656 coefficient/t branches, not raw input pairs.
reduction: Solve 3*A^2*j == epsilon*t modulo 2^m with m15/15/13, use gcd divisibility and the p49 carry upper bound floor(D/2^16); retain every survivor, including nonphysical ones
full_consistency: For every surviving A,t,j, test the finite v,S combinations algebraically to reconstruct X; retain the full equation, BF16 input legality, exact interval/binade and exact J=49-E-S
status_rule: A complete finite residue certificate is labelled computer-assisted, not a pure symbolic theorem or a sample PASS. A relaxed congruence counterexample is not an actual quantizer counterexample.
failure_rule: Any inconsistency between independent references, coefficient classes, or prior declared bounds stops the corresponding conclusion; preserve all failures
forbidden: No raw-code sweep, prior 78552-pair rerun, GPU, compiler/install, optimized kernel, other-paper work, Library duplicate upload, B2 transfer or external human messages
